def solution(t, n, ls, mid, rest)
  answer = []
  return answer
end


# ---- 입출력 코드 ----
def __cib_fail
  raise '__cib_input'
end

def __cib_int(s)
  Integer(s, 10)
rescue StandardError
  __cib_fail
end

def __cib_dbl(s)
  Float(s)
rescue StandardError
  __cib_fail
end

require 'strscan'
$__cib_s = StringScanner.new($stdin.binmode.read.force_encoding(Encoding::UTF_8))

def __cib_more
  $__cib_s.skip(/[ \t\r\n]+/)
  !$__cib_s.eos?
end

def __cib_has
  !$__cib_s.match?(/[ \t\r\n]*[^ \t\r\n]/).nil?
end

def __cib_tok
  $__cib_s.skip(/[ \t\r\n]+/)
  $__cib_s.scan(/[^ \t\r\n]+/) || __cib_fail
end

def __cib_take(n)
  Array.new(n) { __cib_tok }
end

def __cib_nl
  s = $__cib_s
  if s.pos > 0 && s.string.getbyte(s.pos - 1) != 10
    s.skip_until(/\n/) || s.terminate
  end
  nil while s.skip(/[ \t\r]*\n/)
end

def __cib_line
  __cib_fail if $__cib_s.eos?
  $__cib_s.scan(/[^\n]*/).strip
end

def __cib_pos
  $__cib_s.pos
end

def __cib_seek(p)
  $__cib_s.pos = p
end

def __cib_at(w)
  s = __cib_pos
  ok = w.all? { |x| __cib_more && __cib_tok == x }
  __cib_seek(s)
  ok
end

def __cib_rowsTok(w, k)
  s = __cib_pos
  r = 0
  while true
    break if w.empty? ? !__cib_has : __cib_at(w)
    __cib_fail if k < 1 || !__cib_has
    k.times { __cib_tok }
    r += 1
  end
  __cib_seek(s)
  r
end

def __cib_raw
  $__cib_s.scan(/[^\n]*/).rstrip
end

def __cib_isEnd(t, m, e)
  return t == e if m == 1
  return t.start_with?(e) if m == 4
  return false unless m == 2 || m == 3
  f = t.split[0]
  return false if f.nil? || f !~ /\A[+-]?(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)([eE][+-]?\d+)?\z/
  m == 2 ? f.to_f < 0 : f.to_f <= 0
end

def __cib_rowsLine(m, e, text)
  s = __cib_pos
  r = 0
  while true
    __cib_nl
    unless __cib_has
      __cib_fail if m != 0
      break
    end
    t = text ? __cib_raw : __cib_line
    break if m != 0 && __cib_isEnd(t, m, e)
    r += 1
  end
  __cib_seek(s)
  r
end

def __cib_endl(m, e)
  s = __cib_pos
  __cib_nl
  return true if __cib_has && __cib_isEnd(__cib_line, m, e)
  __cib_seek(s)
  false
end

def __cib_bol
  s = $__cib_s
  return unless s.pos > 0 && s.string.getbyte(s.pos - 1) != 10
  s.skip_until(/\n/) || s.terminate
end

def __cib_rawl
  __cib_bol
  s = $__cib_s
  __cib_fail if s.eos?
  t = s.scan(/[^\n]*/)
  s.skip(/\n/)
  t.chomp("\r")
end

def __cib_rowsPhys(m, e)
  s = __cib_pos
  r = 0
  __cib_bol
  while true
    if $__cib_s.eos?
      __cib_fail if m != 0
      break
    end
    t = __cib_rawl.rstrip
    break if m != 0 && __cib_isEnd(t, m, e)
    r += 1
  end
  __cib_seek(s)
  r
end

def __cib_f(r)
  r.map(&:to_s).join('
')
end

def __cib_main
  __cib_o = []
  begin
    __cib_v0 = __cib_rawl
    __cib_v1 = __cib_int(__cib_tok)
    __cib_v2 = Array.new(__cib_v1) { __cib_rawl }
    __cib_v3 = Array.new(__cib_rowsPhys(1, 'END')) { __cib_rawl }
    __cib_rawl
    __cib_v4 = Array.new(__cib_rowsPhys(0, '')) { __cib_rawl }
  rescue StandardError
    __cib_fail
  end
  __cib_o << __cib_f(solution(__cib_v0, __cib_v1, __cib_v2, __cib_v3, __cib_v4))
  $stdout.write(__cib_o.join("\n"), "\n") unless __cib_o.empty?
end

__cib_main
